input.question: Is £650k fair for a 70 sq m flat at SE15 4AN?

result.answer: Yes, £650,000 looks fair for a 70 sq m flat at SE15 4AN, sitting inside the size-adjusted fair range of £587,000 to £789,000 centred on £690,000. That range comes from street-level size-matched sales on Copleston Road, SE15 (n=17, median £9,863 per sq m) against this flat at £9,286 per sq m, while the unadjusted street median is £598,215 (n=18) with the asking price at the 58th percentile.
